release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.25 simplifies Appearance to two supported workspace styles: Sidebar and Top/Classic. Sidebar is the factory/default layout for fresh installations and fresh UI state. Existing installations that previously saved the retired Command Center layout are migrated to Sidebar and that normalized preference is persisted through Tachyon's existing UI-state path. Appearance no longer exposes Command Center as a selectable third shell, reducing the layout/testing matrix while keeping the useful Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette available as a power-user utility from either Sidebar or Top. setLayout now accepts only Sidebar or Classic and fails retired/invalid layout values safely to Sidebar. Appearance copy and layout cards now describe the two-layout product, while navigation order, Quick Sidebar, Neon Accent, density, scale and identity controls remain intact. The Member-versus-Owner binary boundary and private Owner Stable updater remain unchanged, so both audiences receive the same v0.45.25 feature release while member binaries still exclude Owner Vault/private Owner updater modules. PR #337 passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including UI runtime, DOM, source hygiene, race and vulnerability gates, Owner Windows Consumer E2E with real Wails/WebView2, Member Build Boundary with real Wails/WebView2 and exact member artifact checks, and both Go and JavaScript/TypeScript CodeQL high-severity gates before merge.
